paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).
model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the computational cost, measured in Module Giga FLOPs, for four different network modules across three sequential stages of an audio back-end conformer. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Audio back-end Conformer Stage" and displays three groups ordered from left to right: "Stage 1 (d=180, n=500)", "Stage 2 (d=256, n=250)", and "Stage 3 (d=360, n=125)". The vertical value axis is labeled "Module Giga FLOPs" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with numerical tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 0.1. Within each stage, four individual bars are grouped together side-by-side, color-coded according to a legend at the top of the chart: blue for "attention", red for "grouped attention (g=3)", yellow for "patch attention (k=3)", and green for "feed-forward". The tallest bar overall represents the blue "attention" module in Stage 1, with an approximate value of 0.275 Giga FLOPs. The heights of the blue bars visibly decrease across the subsequent stages to approximately 0.16 in Stage 2 and 0.12 in Stage 3. The red "grouped attention" bars decrease from approximately 0.16 in Stage 1 to 0.12 in Stage 2 and 0.105 in Stage 3. The yellow "patch attention" bars also decrease from roughly 0.12 in Stage 1 to 0.105 in Stage 2, reaching the shortest bar overall at approximately 0.10 in Stage 3. Conversely, the green "feed-forward" bars maintain a constant height of approximately 0.13 Giga FLOPs across all three stages. The bars within each group are ordered consistently from left to right according to the legend's sequence, and there are no specific bars visually emphasized with outlines, patterns, or special shading.
